name: Al Masane Al Kobra Mining Company
summary: Established in 2007 and headquartered in Najran, Saudi Arabia, Al Masane Al Kobra Mining Company (AMAK) is a Saudi Arabian enterprise dedicated to the extraction and processing of valuable metals. The firm's core business involves the production of zinc, copper concentrates, silver, and gold. AMAK operates two key mining sites situated in the Najran Province, located in the southwest of the Kingdom: the underground Al Masane mine, which yields copper, zinc, silver, and gold, and the Guyan gold mine.
